description: Renovate on GitHub (Mend app): one PR per update, merged by GitHub auto-merge once test, lint, e2e and review are green. A PR that touches dependency pins only passes review without a Claude run (REVIEW.md, Dependency updates). Majors wait for the dashboard checkbox. The rules below are what vimmary needs from the Forgejo preset local>meltforce.net/homelab, which Renovate on GitHub cannot reach.

customManagers.description: golangci-lint is pinned twice: the prebuilt binary in ci.yml and the go install in scripts/setup. One dependency, so both move in one PR.

packageRules.description: Majors do not merge automatically: tick the checkbox in the dependency dashboard and Renovate opens the PR.
All npm deps share one package-lock.json; bumped individually they conflict with each other. One branch for all non-major JS updates means one lockfile change.
The Vite toolchain majors move in one branch: vitest, vite and @vitejs/plugin-react declare each other in peer ranges and share the lockfile.

The go directive in go.mod names the release setup-go installs and govulncheck checks the standard library of. Renovate reads `go 1.27.4` as `^1.27.4`, which every 1.x satisfies, so without `bump` the line never moves.
A Go minor moves the go directive and the builder image `golang:1.N-alpine` together; a directive ahead of the builder image fails the build. Patches merge automatically.
The Node release of the Dockerfile and of .node-version (CI and scripts/setup) is one version.
pgvector is pinned in compose.test.yaml, compose.e2e.yaml and the test service of ci.yml; production pins it in the homelab repo.

goldmark stays on v1. The v2 module (github.com/yuin/goldmark/v2) changes the import path, which needs gomodUpdateImportPaths rather than gomodTidy, and its API: after rewriting the import in internal/feed/atom.go the build fails with `undefined: goldmark.New` and `undefined: goldmark.Markdown` at three call sites (measured 2026-09-07, go 1.27.1). This is a code migration for that file, not a dependency update.
